purpose: Prevent snapshot ZIP bloat and chat/tooling failures by splitting delivery into deterministic modules.
canonical_truth_rule: DATA/* is source of truth. README is guidance only.

triggers.note: Switch to multi-bundle modules when snapshot ZIP grows beyond this.
File count threshold to keep manifest/checksum operations fast.
Large references should move to legacy bundles.
If uploads/downloads fail, split bundles immediately.
Act packaging needs clean boundaries for playtest gates.

module_layout.notes: Act 1 content subset; prefer explicit allowlist export lists.
Reference docs/media and AI digests. Can be external via LEGACY_BUNDLES registry.

assembly_rules.minimal_change_rule: Only rebuild modules affected by an adjustment.
assembly_rules.auditability: If legacy assets are removed, keep pointer + SHA256 in LEGACY_BUNDLES registry.

when_triggered: Update README with pointers to modules and assembly order.
Update QA: LOG_AJUSTES entry recording the split decision.
chris_sawyer_mode: Deduplicate long narrative into legacy digests; keep DATA as pointers/tags.
Prefer short stable IDs and shared dictionaries.
Prune deprecated legacy assets by reference, not by deleting history.
